text: New AI Image Models: GPT-Image 2.6 & Seedream 5.5 1️⃣ GPT-Image 2.6 , like its predecessor GPT-Image 2.5, is available in two versions: 🔹 Sunburst — prioritizes accuracy and maximum detail. 🔹 Flare — optimized for faster generation. According to user preference rankings , GPT-Image 2.6 and 2.5 perform at roughly the same level, with both ranking among the top image generation models. The outputs may differ slightly between GPT-Image 2.6 and 2.5, as well as between Sunburst and Flare. This gives you more creative flexibility, allowing you to get a wider variety of results using the same prompt across different versions. 🌠 GPT-Image 2.6 can now also generate animated GIFs from text prompts alone or using a reference image, Where to try for free: ChatGPT offers free image generation, but with strict daily limits, 1K resolution, and no indication of which model and quality level is being used. 💎 Paid: All GPT-Image versions, with different quality levels and resolutions up to 4K, are available at discounted prices in @PhotoFixerBot . 2️⃣ Seedream 5.5 — Key Features: 🔹 Image quality comparable to Seedream 5 Pro at a lower cost. 🔹 Multiple rounds of image editing without quality loss. 🔹 Improved texture realism and text rendering. 🔹 40% faster generation. 🔹 Support for transparent PNG images. 🔹 Less restrictive content moderation. 🔹 One of the leading models for image generation. 🔹 Available in @PhotoFixerBot . 📸 NeuralZone
